# Dogfighter for Apple Silicon

> Free setup tools that run Airfix Dogfighter, the Windows game from 2000, on a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later), from your own original CD. The project contains no game files. It is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Unique Development Studios, Paradox Entertainment or Hornby.

Key facts:

- Needs a Mac with M1 or later. macOS 26.4 or later works best. Intel Macs are not supported.
- Needs your original Airfix Dogfighter CD and a CD drive, or a BIN/CUE copy of the whole disc. An ISO file does not work: it has no music.
- Needs about 6.2 GB of free disk space (about 5 GB for the game, about 1.2 GB for sharper textures) and an internet connection while you install.
- The game runs through Wine. Setup makes sharper textures on your Mac from your own game files; nothing is uploaded.

Install, in Terminal:

1. Install Apple's command line tools: `xcode-select --install`
2. Only on macOS older than 26.4, install Rosetta 2: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`
3. Get the project: `git clone https://github.com/natemate90/dogfighter.git && cd dogfighter`
4. Copy your disc to a file: `brew install cdrdao`, then `cdrdao read-cd --read-raw --datafile Dogfighter.bin --driver generic-mmc:0x20000 Dogfighter.toc`
5. Run setup: `./setup.sh` (add `--language=French`, `--language=German` or `--language=Italian` for another language)
6. Play: `./dogfighter`, or double-click `Dogfighter.app`. If something goes wrong, run `./dogfighter --doctor`.
